description: A React-like component for rendering a product card, using LightningJs Blits framework. It manages properties such as image, name, and price, and updates its display accordingly.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A minimal product card component that displays product image, name, and price with reactive updates based on the 'item' property.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes watchers and sets up reactive binding for the 'item' property.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles user interaction to navigate to the product detail page based on 'item.id'.
